contents.text: {"hypotheses":[{"experiment_id":"tight_A5","text":"If CB Felix Ondo had been 5 m closer to Leo Marchetti, the chance to score would have fallen from 6.7% to 5.6% (largest reduction), showing stronger central defensive pressure on the passer would most reduce the chance."},{"experiment_id":"tight_A9","text":"If CF Yusuf Benali had been 3 m closer to Leo Marchetti, the chance to score would have fallen from 6.7% to 6.1%, indicating nearer forward pressure on the passer slightly lowers the scoring chance."},{"experiment_id":"tight_A8","text":"If CM Theo Varga had been 4 m closer to Leo Marchetti, the chance to score would have fallen from 6.7% to 6.3%, so tighter midfield marking on the passer has a modest negative effect on the chance."}]}
